[LTIE.4.8] **What a `publish` judges.** The engine must judge a `publish`'s values
as it judges an `emit`'s: it fills `ts` first ([LFAC.9.2]), a fault in a slot value
abandons the activation ([LERR.1]), a value its slot does not admit raises a
`TypeError` ([RARC.5.2.7]), and a `String` longer than its slot's `capacity` is
refused ([LSTR.11.3]). A `publish` the engine refuses sends nothing. No bound on
working memory or a series applies to a `publish`, and it has no deadline.
